longBusinessSummary: SuperX AI Technology Limited provides AI infrastructure solutions in Japan and internationally. The company offers AI servers under the SuperX brand. It also provides advanced solution design and planning, infrastructure product integration, and end-to-end operations and maintenance; AI cloud, cloud computing, and agents; deployment, warranty, hosting, and technical development services; supercomputer equipment; and technical services. In addition, the company offers GPUaaS, which delivers GPU cloud hosting, model deployment, and monitoring and operations capabilities; AI model application programming interface (API) services, which provide customers with programmatic access to open-source and other third-party AI models hosted on our cloud infrastructure; and AI Token Platform, which provides unified access to third-party AI models through a single interface. Further, it resells AI data
